before_conditions: A user has earned rewards during bonding.
The user transfers tokens, which triggers unstaking.
The rewards system is designed to distribute earned fees to users when they unbond or claim.
required_property: When a user's token transfer triggers unstaking after graduation, the rewards earned during bonding should be sent to that user.
bad_outcome: The rewards are incorrectly sent to the launchpad contract instead of the user, causing the user to lose access to their rewards, which accumulate in the launchpad contract.
